units.en: ⟦0⟧ is a minor country in Central Europe with a population of ⟦1⟧. It borders ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ to the north, ⟦4⟧ to the west, ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ to the south and ⟦7⟧ to the east.

The Republic of German-Austria (Or Republik Deutschösterreich or Deutsch-Österreich) was formed in 1918 after the abdication of the Emperor Carl I with the Social Democrat Karl Renner as Chancellor of Austria. And as one of the defeated powers of WWI Austria was forced to signed the Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye. The territory of Austria was greatly reduced to 25% of its original territory, forced to reduce the army to 30 000 and to pay war reparations. Ethnic Germans were separated from Austrian lands as a result. To make it worse, the newly landlocked Austria lost their ability to trade via the sea, causing their economic situation to collapse. Austria also became dependent on its neighbors for trade, particularly the newly formed Weimar Republic to the north.

In 1927, during a political clash in Schattendorf, an old man and a child were shot and killed by Heimwehr. On 14 July 1927 the shooters were acquitted and left-wing supporters began a massive protest during which the Ministry of Justice building was burned. To restore order police and army shot and killed 89 people and injured 600. The huge protest is known as the July Revolt of 1927. Social Democrats called for a general strike which lasted four days.
After the 1927 events the conservative elements became stronger and violence in Austria continued to escalate until the early 1930s when Engelbert Dollfuss became Chancellor.

⟦0⟧ gets a unique national focus tree as part of the ⟦1⟧ expansion. Without the expansion, Austria utilizes the ⟦2⟧. Should ⟦3⟧ complete the focuses ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧ or if ⟦6⟧ completes the focuses ⟦7⟧ or ⟦8⟧ either as a vassal or a leader, it gives Austria a new branch.
The Lands of the Crown of Saint Stephen
The Austrian national focus tree can be divided into 7 branches and 14 sub-branches and 1 joint branch:

The branch allows Austria to repeal the May Constitution, end Austrofascism, and legalize political opposition. It strengthens ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ support while reducing fascist influence, stabilizes the country, and introduces new political advisors and operatives. It opens up to the ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ sub-branches.

The start of this section gives Austria the ⟦0⟧ modifier, bans the Austrian ⟦1⟧ party and sets up a civil war. During the civil war, Austria may request aid from the ⟦2⟧ or raid the old stockpiles and go it alone. It may either join the Comintern or create a communist faction. Austria will then be able to expand communism in the Danube and may then go to war with the ⟦3⟧ or ⟦4⟧.
Gain Schutzbund Support/Intervention in Spain/Universität Wien Branch

These sections are shared between the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ sub-branches. The top section gains militia units. The middle section allows Austria to help ⟦2⟧ in their civil war. the bottom section gives research bonuses.
The ⟦0⟧ sub-branch allows the country to create a republic with support from the democratic majors. It may either join the allies or create an Alpine faction.
The shared ⟦0⟧ and Danubian Federation sub-branch allows the removal of the Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye, gain military and industry bonuses and an Intelligence agency.
Deal with the German Threat Sub-branch
This shared ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and Danubian Federation focuses allow Austria to go to war with ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ countries.

This path creates the Danubian Federation and brings other countries to the faction, including ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ or the ⟦3⟧. It allows the ⟦4⟧. It allows the creation of the ⟦5⟧ or the Danubian State of Austria.
The beginning of the ⟦0⟧ path. It leads to both the main ⟦1⟧ path and the Danubian Federation path. It reinstalls ⟦2⟧ as leader, or ⟦3⟧ if ⟦4⟧ reinstalled ⟦5⟧ as their king.
The Legacy of an Empire Sub-branch
This path restores the Austrian Empire. It sets up the nation with industry, ⟦0⟧, War support, military bonuses and an intelligence agency for further expansion.
This shared Danubian Federation and ⟦0⟧ focuses allow Austria to go to war with the ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ countries.
The subjugation sub-branch for the ⟦0⟧ branch puppets ⟦1⟧ and other Austro-Hungarian nations which unlocks the ⟦2⟧. It also gives historically Austrian states from ⟦3⟧ and cores them.
These shared focuses between the ⟦0⟧ subjugation path and the annexation path allows Austria to ally the ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ as well as demand the original seat of the House of Habsburg from ⟦3⟧.
Reform the Central Powers/Strength in Numbers/The War Against the Guarantors/Proclaim the Austrian Empire/An Austrian Future/The Second Brothers War Branch

These focuses are shared between the ⟦0⟧ branch and the historical branch as well as the subjugation and annexation sub-branches. The upper part joins either the Central Powers or the Axis. The second part gains war goals against the ⟦1⟧ majors. the third part restores the ⟦2⟧. The lower part gains a War goal against ⟦3⟧ and allows the decision to core some or all of the ⟦4⟧ states.
Restoring the Right to Our Flag/Purchasing Alaska Sub-branch

These focuses are only available when ⟦0⟧ becomes leader of Austria if ⟦1⟧ becomes a general via event after selecting the ⟦2⟧. It replaces Austria with ⟦3⟧. It may then either go to war with ⟦4⟧ for the flag, or purchase ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧.
Bring Hungary Back Into the Fold Sub-branch
This path is the ⟦0⟧ and historical annexation sub-branch. It annexes ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ and other Balkan territories.

The historical branch sets Austria as a ⟦0⟧ nation against ⟦1⟧ and combats against ⟦2⟧'s Anschluss with support from ⟦3⟧ and the ⟦4⟧ majors. It may support ⟦5⟧ in its civil war. It gives military bonuses by modifying ⟦6⟧.
The industry branch increases resource extraction and creation, ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, and help recover from the Great Depression.
The airforce branch gives bonuses to airforce technology, ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ as well as upgrade the modifier ⟦3⟧.
The army branch rearms Austria, gives army bonuses, design companies and ⟦0⟧ as well as upgrade the modifier ⟦1⟧ and its equivalents.
This branch gives bonus to Austria's Naval industry and technology as well as upgrades the Modifier ⟦0⟧ and its equivalents.

The Austro-Hungarian joint branch gives military and industry bonuses to Austria and other members within historical Austria Hungary. This branch allows any member/subject to complete the focus. The originator will be able to form ⟦0⟧. It is unlocked when ⟦1⟧ completes the focuses ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧.
The Austro-Hungarian joint branch, available with the ⟦0⟧ DLC:
The Austro-Hungarian branch can be divided into 4 sections:
Gives army experience and research bonuses to army research, and as well as national spirits for every type of infantry unit.
Gives economic experience and research bonuses in joint cooperations, as well as national spirits for economy.
Builds civilian factories (usually even if building slots are already full), infrastructure and grants national spirits for the industry wise.
Convene the Imperial Diet/United in the Face of Danger Sub-branch
This is done either by Hungary or Austria which gives a final modification on every member's national spirit, as well as grant a small political power, but with the cost of daily autonomy loss.
